flows:

Use only its listed roles, names and controls.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
In Reading view, first verify the exact row label ‘searchbox · Search products’.
If that named searchbox is absent, @v16:"report a failure and stop".
Use only the named searchbox to type speaker and submit.
Confirm one result named Porch Speaker.
